description: Start shopping for the insurance products the customer asked for. If a shopping intent for exactly these products is already open, it resumes that one. Pass the main facts you already know in application, so the status asks only for the rest. application takes the main fields only: send any other fact with jerry_update_application right after. Returns the status, with rejected and clarify. When a fact comes from anything other than the customer, sources says where, and permission holds the customer's reply allowing it.
